concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a bigger DRAGONFLY DRAGON with larger wings, the SECOND stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line whose first stage is image 6: a slim teal dragonfly dragon with a cream belly, pale mint dragonfly wings, feathery antennae, a white wind ring above its head and a swirling wind gem on its chest, in the same view and pose as image 1, hovering with its big wings spread wide, both short legs raised in front of its belly and its tail curling down under it, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 head with face; 2 two feathery antennae; 3 ear fins and head crest; 4 white wind ring; 5 body and collar fins; 6 swirling wind gem; 7 two big dragonfly wings; 8 two legs; 9 tail with dragonfly tip; 10 two hip streamers;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 head with face: a slim teal-jade dragon head with the same outline: a pointed teal ear on top, two small pale mint marks above the eye, cream lower jaw, a small teal cheek frill, one big deep navy-blue eye exactly where the old eye is (one small catchlight dot), brows angled down, a confident grin with a small fang; no orange petal markings, no leaf-green.
2 two feathery antennae: two feathery antennae like a moth's, rising from the same spots and leaning the same way as the antlers: a thin teal shaft with soft pale mint feather barbs on both sides, about as long as the old antlers; no brown, no antlers, no tines.
3 ear fins and head crest: swept-back fins: the mane becomes a crest of three pointed teal fin spikes with pale mint webbing swept back to the viewer-left; the ear behind the head becomes a darker teal pointed fin ear; the small back piece a short dark teal fin; no leaf shapes, no spots.
4 white wind ring: a ring of white wind floating at the same place and tilt: a thin white swirling band made of two curling wind streaks with small curled ends, ink outline and a few pale blue-grey swirl lines; flat white, no glow, no cyan.
5 body and collar fins: a slim teal-jade dragon body with a warm cream belly marked by soft segment lines; the two scarf pieces become two pale mint wind-streamer fins with dark teal swirls, same shapes and places; no leaf-green, no yellow.
6 swirling wind gem: a round wind gem, same size and place: white and pale blue with a darker blue spiral swirl inside, flat colours; no flame, no orange, no glass shine, no glow.
7 two big dragonfly wings: bigger dragonfly wings than the first stage's: each wing-arm becomes a slim teal leading edge (the wing's front rib), and each panel becomes one long narrow dragonfly wing blade, flat pale mint with a fine dark teal vein network and a rounded tip, same place and direction as the panel and a little longer; no yellow, no feathers, no bat-wing membrane.
8 two legs: two short teal-jade legs with cream soles and small cream claws, same pieces, bends and directions; no leaf-green, no brown.
9 tail with dragonfly tip: a slim teal-jade tail with a cream underside, same curl; the tip becomes the end of a dragonfly's abdomen: three short teal segments with dark teal rings ending in two small pointed pale mint claspers, same place and size as the old tip; no leaf shape, no diamond.
10 two hip streamers: two long thin teal fin streamers with pale mint edges, same place, length and curve, like trailing wind ribbons; no leaf-green.

ATTITUDE: a fierce, confident dragon ready to dive: brows angled down, a sharp grin with a small fang; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those. Image 6 is the approved first stage of this creature: keep its colours, face and drawing style; this stage is the same creature grown up.

COLOURS: a teal-jade (blue-green) body, head, fins, legs and tail, a warm cream belly, jaw and soles, pale mint dragonfly wing blades with a fine dark teal vein network, pale mint feathery antennae on teal shafts, a white wind ring, a white-and-pale-blue wind gem with a blue spiral, deep navy-blue eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: a banana-green or leaf-green body, brown antlers, a glowing cyan halo, an orange flame or fire ball, a glass bubble, yellow or olive wings, bat-wing membranes, a leaf-shaped or diamond tail tip, orange petal markings around the eye, red eyes, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
